run_rerank_text: run text-only reranking via /rerank endpoint with query and list of documents
run_score_text: run text-only scoring via /score endpoint with query and list of documents
run_score_text_top_n: run text reranking with top_n filtering via /rerank endpoint to return only top results
run_score_text_vs_images: run multi-modal scoring with a text query against image documents via /score endpoint
run_rerank_text_vs_images: run multi-modal reranking with a text query against image documents via /rerank endpoint
